name: Atorvastatin
executiveSummary: High-intensity statin. Adult: **10–80 mg PO at night** (usual start **10–20 mg**; high intensity **40–80 mg**). Pediatrics ≥10 y (familial hyperlipidemia): **10–20 mg/day** (usual max **40 mg**). Avoid in pregnancy.
indications:
## Indications

- Hypercholesterolemia; primary/secondary CV prevention.
- Familial dyslipidemia (including selected adolescents).

## Precautions

- Myopathy/rhabdomyolysis — watch muscle pain; risk ↑ with CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, itraconazole, grapefruit), gemfibrozil.
- Monitor CK/LFTs per protocol.
- Contraindicated in pregnancy and active liver disease.

> Prefer evening dosing; with or without food.

adulto.dose: Start: **10–20 mg PO/day**. Titrate q4 weeks. Secondary prevention/high risk: **40–80 mg/day**. Max **80 mg/day**.
adulto.notes: Caution with interactions or severe renal impairment.

pediatrico.dose: ≥10 y (FH/hyperlipidemia): start **10 mg/day**; usual max **20–40 mg/day** per label/specialist.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Myalgia, ↑ CK, ↑ LFTs, headache, GI upset; rare: rhabdomyolysis, new-onset diabetes.
